title: Rigi oder Pilatus
desc: A question that is not a normal question
setting: A table above the lake, two empty glasses, and a man at the next table already listening.

options.feedback: The safe answer, and he will ask again. Nobody in this canton is allowed to have no opinion on this.
An answer, said without hedging. It starts an argument and the argument is the point.
His answer. You will get forty minutes of agreement, which is less fun and perfectly pleasant.
Steiler, with er on the end. A comparative and a reason, which is what he asked for.

options.es: Der Pilatus ist besser als die Rigi.
options.feedback: Besser als is right and it is not a reason. He already knows what you think.
Then do not pick a side. Having one and not defending it is the worst of both.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Auf der Rigi kann meine Grossmutter laufen.
steps.en: My grandmother can walk on Rigi.

options.es: Das stimmt. Das ist ein Berg für Menschen.
options.en: That is true. That is a mountain for people.
options.feedback: Give him the point. He has been waiting to make it and it is a good one.

options.en: Mine could too, on the railway.
options.feedback: A joke back, at the same volume as his. That is how this argument is supposed to go.
It is his argument, and it is about his grandmother. Read the room.
He said two words to a table he is not at and then finished his beer. Nothing is required of you.

options.en: You see, I am on my own.
options.feedback: Fine and it invites him in. He was not asking to join, he was registering a vote.
He is not going to explain. He said the name of a mountain and that was the whole contribution.
